description: Create (no id) or update (id) a fitness test plan of an agent. Required on create: agent_id, name, test_ids (ordered ids of this agent's cases), takt (manuell|taeglich|woechentlich). uhrzeit = local time Europe/Zurich, default 06:30; wochentag 1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday (woechentlich, default 1). pflicht (default true) = counts for «fit». bei_rot = {ticket: bool, nachricht_an_user_ids: [], nachricht_kanal: "mail"}. next_run_at is computed. Admins, planners and agents with the right only.

bei_rot.description: Actions on a red result: {ticket, nachricht_an_user_ids, nachricht_kanal}

beschreibung.description: Free-text description of the test plan

id.description: ID of an existing test plan to update; omit to create

name.description: Name of the agent test plan

pflicht.description: Whether the plan counts towards the agent's fit status; default true

takt.description: How often the plan runs; required on create

wochentag.description: Weekday for weekly plans, 1 = Monday to 7 = Sunday; default 1

name: upsert_agent_test_plan
